title: OKStatus · Uptime overview
description: Every monitor of an OKStatus organization, from its Prometheus export (GET /api/v1/metrics): status, response times per probe region, availability against the SLA target, expirations, private agents. https://okstatus.eu/docs/integrations/prometheus/

panels.title: Monitors
panels.description: Monitors of the organization matching the filters.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Up on the majority of their probe regions.

panels.title: Degraded
panels.description: At least one probe region failing, or slow responses, without a majority down.

panels.title: Down
panels.description: Down on the majority of their probe regions: the rule OKStatus alerts on.

panels.title: Availability · $window
panels.description: Mean availability over the window: the same figure as the dashboard, status pages and SLA reports.

panels.title: Error budget left · $window
panels.description: Share of the downtime allowed by the organization SLA target that is still unspent over the window.

panels.title: Certs < 14 d
panels.description: TLS certificates expiring within 14 days.

panels.title: Private agents
panels.description: Private agents that sent a heartbeat in the last 90 seconds.

panels.title: Status history
panels.description: Monitor state over time, under the majority rule.

targets.expr:
max by (monitor_id, monitor_name) (
    (okstatus_monitor_status{state="up", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 1
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state="degraded", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 2
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state="down", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 3
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state="maintenance", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 4
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state="paused", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 5
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state=~"pending|stale", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 6
)

panels.title: Needs attention
panels.description: Monitors down or degraded right now, with how many probe regions fail.

targets.expr: max by (monitor_id, monitor_name, monitor_group, monitor_type, monitor_host, state) (okstatus_monitor_status{state=~"down|degraded", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1)

defaults.noValue: Nothing to report: every monitor is up

panels.title: Response time · heatmap
panels.description: Every last-check latency sample, all monitors and regions, bucketed by Grafana.

panels.title: Response time by probe region
panels.description: Mean of the last check per region (solid) and the hourly p95 rollup (dashed).

panels.title: Status by probe region
panels.description: Last check of every monitor from every probe region it runs from.

panels.title: Availability vs SLA target · $window
panels.description: Availability of each monitor over the window. Thresholds: 99.5 % and 99.9 %.

panels.title: Monitors
panels.description: One row per monitor. Click a header to sort.

targets.expr: max by (monitor_id, monitor_name, monitor_group, monitor_type, monitor_host) (okstatus_monitor_info{monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"})

max by (monitor_id) (
    (okstatus_monitor_status{state="up", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 1
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state="degraded", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 2
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state="down", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 3
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state="maintenance", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 4
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state="paused", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 5
  or (okstatus_monitor_status{state=~"pending|stale", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"} == 1) * 6
)

panels.title: Upcoming expirations
panels.description: Days left before each TLS certificate and registered domain expires.

panels.title: Private agents
panels.description: Agents running in your own infrastructure: liveness, version and load.

targets.expr: max by (agent_id, agent_name, site, version, platform) (okstatus_private_agent_info)

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: AI model monitors: time to the first token of the last check.

panels.title: Time per output token
panels.description: AI model monitors: mean time per output token after the first.

panels.title: Downtime · $window
panels.description: Time spent down over the window, monitors with downtime only.

panels.title: Error budget left per monitor · $window
panels.description: Monitor SLA target when set, organization target otherwise.

targets.expr:
clamp(
  1 - (1 - okstatus_monitor_availability_ratio{window="$window", monitor_group=~"$group", monitor_name=~"$monitor"})
    / on (monitor_id) group_left ()
      (1 - (okstatus_monitor_sla_target_ratio or on (monitor_id) (0 * okstatus_monitor_check_interval_seconds + scalar(okstatus_org_sla_target_ratio)))),
  0, 1)
